reviews.name: Machined
reviews.premise: Space Grotesk's squared-off curves echo the hinge's machined corners; Inter keeps the panel quiet and readable. Code and logs: JetBrains Mono.

reviews.name: Squircle
reviews.premise: Sora is built on the same squared circle as the hinge itself, so mark and wordmark share one shape; Public Sans stays plain and open for the panel. Code and logs: Source Code Pro.
